# Thesis Generator

> AI-powered thesis writing assistant that helps graduate students and researchers structure, draft, and refine academic papers with proper formatting, citations, and data visualization.

## About

Thesis Generator (thesisgenerator.io) is an AI-powered academic writing assistant for graduate students, PhD candidates, and researchers. It helps users overcome writer's block by generating structured first drafts that serve as a strong starting point for further research and editing. The tool assists with organizing thesis structure, drafting chapters, formatting citations, and creating data tables and charts — saving researchers weeks of initial structuring work so they can focus on their original analysis and insights.

Thesis Generator is designed as a productivity tool similar to Grammarly, Zotero, or Overleaf — it assists and accelerates the writing process while users retain full control over their content and are expected to incorporate their own research, data, and critical analysis.

## Key Features

- Structured thesis drafting with proper chapter organization (introduction, literature review, methodology, results, discussion, conclusion)
- Auto-generated data tables and charts to visualize research concepts
- PDF, DOCX, and LaTeX export formats for academic workflows
- Multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Chinese, and more)
- Reference document uploads — users can provide their own sources for the AI to incorporate
- Section-level editing and regeneration for iterative refinement
- APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard citation style formatting
- Works across all academic fields: Computer Science, Business, Psychology, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Social Sciences, Humanities, etc.
- Real-time progress tracking as chapters are drafted

## Academic Integrity

Thesis Generator is a writing assistant, not a replacement for original research. Users are expected to:
- Review and edit all generated content
- Add their own research findings, data, and analysis
- Verify all citations and references
- Follow their institution's academic integrity guidelines regarding AI tool usage
- Use generated drafts as a starting point for their own work

The tool is comparable to other widely accepted academic aids like grammar checkers, reference managers, and LaTeX editors — it helps with structure and drafting while the intellectual contribution remains the student's.

## Pricing

- **Free**: $0/month — 1 draft per month, up to 10 chapters, 7-day access, 2 reference uploads
- **Pro**: $9/month — 5 drafts per month, unlimited chapters, PDF/DOCX/LaTeX export, no expiry, 10 reference uploads
- **Pro Unlimited**: $19/month — Unlimited drafts, unlimited chapters, all export formats, priority processing, 10 reference uploads
- **One-Time Export**: $4 — Export a single thesis without subscribing

## How It Works

1. Enter your research topic, academic field, and preferred writing style
2. AI creates a structured outline with chapter suggestions and subheadings
3. A first draft is generated chapter by chapter with tables, charts, and citation placeholders
4. Review, edit, add your own research, and export in your preferred format
